title: Dripping Defeat

He is performing a dramatic face-paw sigh with an exhausted, humbled expression. In the background, behind a large oak tree, the Forest Friends (a white rabbit with a yellow scarf, a light brown squirrel with a blue messenger bag, and a lavender hedgehog with a red beret) peek out with amused, wide-eyed expressions.
